attributes.action: Fully electrify the Midland Main Line to Leicester, Nottingham, and Sheffield
attributes.additional_details: As a lot of people may know, the DfT paused Midland Main Line wiring just five miles short of Leicester at South Wigston. This short-sighted halt leaves roughly £30 million of already-installed infrastructure completely dead in a field. Furthermore, it forces train drivers to execute highly stressful, precisely timed on-the-move power changeovers at 100 mph. Relying on bi-mode diesel power is an expensive, lazy half-measure.
attributes.background: The DfT has paused Midland Main Line wiring, leaving it 5 miles short of Leicester. This wastes millions and keeps Sheffield as the UK's largest city without electric rail. Bi-mode diesel is an expensive half-measure. We call on the DfT to fully fund the entire route to Sheffield now.

rejection.details:
We can’t accept petitions that call for action at a local level even when it is something that the UK Government or Parliament is responsible for.

You could ask your MP to take action on your concerns about this issue, including by asking them to present a public (paper) petition about this.

You can find contact details for your local MP here: https://members.parliament.uk/FindYourMP

And you can find out how to ask your MP to present a public (paper) petition here: https://www.parliament.uk/get-involved/sign-a-petition/paper-petitions/
